name: FeWo Biohof Planer
beschreibung: The FeWo Biohof Planer is located in a quiet valley in the Tiroler Alpen. The surroundings are characterized by alpine meadows and dense forests. The inn features rustic furnishings and a family-run atmosphere. Guests are offered regional cuisine with products from its own organic farm. In summer, hiking and cycling tours are possible on marked trails. In winter, the nearby ski areas and cross-country ski trails are easily accessible. The farm places emphasis on sustainability and direct marketing of its products.
